records.issue_text: AssertEvents extracts the grant shortcut using substring(3, 5) instead of substring(4, 6), reading the wrong characters.
records.rationale: The finding identifies a real bug in the isAccessTokenId matcher. Looking at the diff at line 483: `if (items[0].substring(3, 5).equals(expectedGrantShortcut)) return false;` - this logic is inverted. When the grant shortcut MATCHES the expected value, it returns false (rejecting the match), and when it DOESN'T match, it continues to check the UUID. This is backwards - it should return false when the shortcut does NOT equal the expected value.
